content: Pwehki Sohp eh ngidingidki eh mwakelekel, ohl silimeno ahpw sohla song en sapeng ih.

Ahpw ohl emen me ede Elihu me iang mihmi wasao ahpw sohla kak kanengamahiong eh lingeringer, pwehki Sohp eh akupwungki pein ih oh kapwukohnki Koht mehkoaros. (Elihu nein Parakel pwutak, kadaudok en Pus, oh kisehn peneineien Ram.)
E pil lingeringer pahn kompoakepahn Sohp ohl silimeno. Ar sohte kak sapeng Sohp, oh met likamwete Koht me sapwung.
Pwehki Elihu me keieu pwulopwul wasao, kahrehda e sohte iang pato lao irail kaimwisakala arail pato kan.
Ni eh patohwan me ohl silimeno sohte kak sapeng Sohp, e ahpw lingeringerda

content.text: I me pwulopwul, a kumwail me mah,
eri, I masak patohwanohng kumwail dahme I medemedewe.
I medemedewe me kumwail me uhdahn pahn mahsen,
kumwail me mah kan uhdahn pahn sawaski amwail kupwurokong.
Ahpw iet pwe ngenen Koht Wasa Lapalahpie
me kin ketikidohng aramas kupwurokong.
Kaidehn aramas ar kin mahla me kahrehiong ar kin kupwurokongla
de kahrehiong ar pahn ese dahme pwung.
Eri, met I men kumwail en karonge ie mahs;
I pahn patohwanohng kumwail ei tungoal lamalam.
I nennenla rongorong nindokon amwail mahmahsen
oh awiawih amwail raparapahki mahsen en kupwurokong kan.
I tehk ni keneinei, I ahpw diarada me kumwail sohte pweida;
kumwail sohte kasapwunge dahme Sohp koasoiaier.
Ia duwen amwail kak koasoia me kumwail diaradahr kupwurokong?
Koht uhdahn pahn sapeng Sohp, pwe kumwail sohte kakohng.
Sohp mahseniong kumwail, e sohte mahseniong ie,
eri, ei pasapeng sohte mwahn pahn duwehte amwail.
Maing Sohp, arail koasoi kan sohte wia sawas ehu;
sohte me re kak sapengkin komwi.
Ia duwe, I en awiawih ni arail nennenlahr?
Re kesikesihnenehr solahr me re pahn koasoia.
Soh, I pahn wiahier pein ei pasapeng met
oh patohwanohng komwi dahme ei tungoal lamalam.
I solahr kak nennenla.
I solahr kak kolokol ei pato kan.
Ma sohte ei ahnsou mwahu en pato,
I pahn sawapeseng rasehng edin wain me direkihla wain kapw.
I solahr kak kanengamah; I uhdahn pahn pato.
I sohte pahn uhpalihki emen nan akupwungpene wet;
I sohte pahn kapinga emen.
I sohte kin ese mwomwen lokaiahn kaping,
oh Koht pahn mwadangete kalokei ie ma I pahn wia met.
